perspective:
**Ethan’s available information / subjective reconstruction:**

- Ethan knows his own identity and background: he is Ethan Mohamud, a plumber; he has a long-time close friendship with Gary Guo from middle school, and they rely on each other for support. He knows Gary is a doctor.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He became concerned about Gary’s health.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation/rejuvenation. He told Gary his health mattered and asked him to go for two days. He heard Gary refuse, saying there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected Gary’s overworking was about more than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school and Gary could tell him anything without judgment. Gary replied that it was complicated and he didn’t want to burden Ethan.
- After that, Gary opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan felt relief and empathy. He suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities. Gary agreed and said he needed help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and challenges, and saw Gary making efforts to change. Ethan felt hopeful and proud. He told Gary he was proud and available to talk. Gary said things were better, he was less overwhelmed, and he had time for a movie.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary managing a healthier work-life balance on his own. Ethan felt satisfied and happy for him. He decided to step back while remaining available. He told Gary he was always a call away and to keep up the good work. Gary thanked him, said he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and felt more in control.

Ethan does **not** have access to hidden events, Gary’s private thoughts, or narrator-only information unless Gary told him or Ethan directly observed it.
